text:
Elena Park: @here Heads-up: rolling out a new Private deployment policy next Monday that changes the default telemetry and ties a limited set of enhanced telemetry to SLA credits. Short version: default = minimal telemetry (health + errors), customers can opt into Enhanced Telemetry for SLA windows and faster support, and we added a Data Usage Addendum to clearly prohibit training on customer data. See details below.

Samir Dutta: Nice. Does this apply to current Dedicated tenants or just new Private installs?

Elena Park: Applies to new Private installs and to Dedicated customers who accept the updated SLA. Existing Dedicated customers will get a notification and a 30-day opt-in grace period; no forced changes without consent.

Maya Patel (Legal): Confirming — we published a short Addendum (linked in the doc) that customers must accept to enable Enhanced Telemetry. Main points: no model training on customer data, telemetry is hashed/aggregated, retention default 30 days, export for audits on request, and a clear opt-out. Language is narrow and customer-friendly.

Marco Li: From product/console side: added a settings toggle under Settings > Telemetry > Enhanced (opt-in). For Private/on-prem there is a consent-check tool we will ship in the agent (v3.2.0). For customers who want SLA credits but refuse telemetry, we have a manual attestation + SLA exception flow (support-assisted). Docs: https://intranet.redwood/priv-sla-data-usage (internal)

Elena Park: Rollout plan: Monday 09:00 PT — agent v3.2.0 with consent-check; 09:15 PT — console flag and docs live; 09:30 PT — email to affected Dedicated customers with opt-in link. Please don't push other major changes that morning.

OpsBot: deploy:agent-v3.2.0 started (job 78322).

SRE Oncall: Two quick Qs — 1) rollback plan if consent-check breaks installs? 2) telemetry volume estimates for alerting?

Marco Li: 1) Agent ship includes a --skip-consent-check CLI flag for installers and a one-click rollback to v3.1.9 in the console for managed customers. 2) Enhanced telemetry increases event volume by ~8-12% in synthetic tests; default/minimal should be ~2% overhead. I've linked a sizing doc in the runbook.

Maya Patel (Legal): Also note privacy/regulatory callouts: for EU customers we default to minimal and require explicit signed addendum for Enhanced. Customers in regulated industries should get direct SE outreach.

Elena Park: Support playbook: support -> product -> legal escalation path included in the runbook. If you get a customer pushback, do not enable Enhanced without signed addendum.

Samir Dutta: Can we get a short canned email + FAQ for SEs?

Marco Li: Yep, drafting now. Will post a template in #sales later today and drop into the docs.

Elena Park: Thanks all. Action items: Marco — docs + SE email; Maya — finalize addendum & one-pager; SRE Oncall — verify alert thresholds with expected telemetry delta; Eng Infra — freeze unrelated deploys Monday morning. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: deploy:agent-v3.2.0 succeeded (job 78322).

SRE Oncall: Verified telemetry delta in staging; alerts adjusted. All good from SRE side. :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel (Legal): Addendum uploaded to legal repo and linked in the public doc.

Elena Park: Great — closing the announce thread. If you need edits to the FAQ or rollout timeline, reply here.

Samir Dutta: Thanks — will prep customer list for outreach.
